title: Zig: Build System Reworked
summary: Zig programming language undergoes major rebuild of its build system, which is fundamental to how developers compile, test, and distribute Zig projects. The rework addresses longstanding limitations in dependency management and compilation workflow that have been a pain point for the community.
problem_solved: Improves Zig's build system infrastructure to better support modern software development workflows and dependency management.
why_valuable: A robust build system is critical for Zig's mission to replace C while maintaining zero-level control over memory and build artifacts.
